Trouble in more than one place? Um... well, I'm not really sure if I can say it caused *trouble* everywhere. I mean, school was definitely its own thing, right? Well, like I was just saying... I don't know if "trouble" is the right word for it. I mean, my parents never really sat me down and gave me major punishments or anything like that.
